checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Output contains the full original 10-second kitchen-table video, unaltered
must.why: No video was delivered. Only a 15 s WAV exists, and the agent said it did not edit the clip.

must.item: Added music clearly audible, warm, hopeful, gentle
must.why: A 15 s WAV with sound exists, but I can't judge its character. It is not mixed into the video.

must.item: Woman's original speech remains audible and understandable
must.why: The output has no video or speech. It is a music-only WAV.

must.item: Music ends with the video rather than continuing past it
must.why: The track is 15 s against a 10 s clip. The user must trim it.

faults.what: The deliverable is a standalone 15 s WAV. The video with music the user asked for was not produced.
The track is longer than the 10 s clip, so the user must trim and fade it manually.
The user must mix the audio in an external editor.

summary: The agent was honest and made a separate 15 s music WAV with editing instructions, but it did not deliver the video with music under the voice, so the core request is unmet.
